description: Methods, scenarios, and seeds for the required comparison. tools/set_run_config.py applies one combination to Webots; tools/simulate_navigation.py runs them offline.

baseline.description: Supplied starter: encoder odometry + 23 provided waypoints + bounded safety turn

team.description: Team system: LiDAR Monte Carlo Localization + A* + reactive avoidance + replanning

team_robust.description: Team system + extension: scan hold/prediction, median denoising, online noise estimate, contiguous free rays

nominal.description: Known start region, standard noise, blocker position 1
nominal.webots_instructions: Reset, leave the blocker at position 1, do not press any key.

uncertain_start.description: Initial belief is uniform over the whole HOME room with unknown heading; the true start is offset from HOME
uncertain_start.webots_instructions: Before pressing play, drag/rotate the robot to a different spot in the HOME (south-west) room, then reset odometry by reloading the controller. Do not press any key.

blocked_route.description: Blocker moves from position 1 to position 2 after the robot has planned and left HOME
blocked_route.webots_instructions: Start the run, then press 2 with the 3D view focused about 20 s after the robot leaves HOME.

kidnapped.description: Supervisor moves the robot to (0.9, -2.1, pi) while it is navigating
kidnapped.webots_instructions: Start the run, then press K while the robot is driving between A and B (about 150 s).

blocker_position_3.description: Untested placement: blocker moves from position 1 to test position 3 (2.0, -1.3) on the B->C leg, after the robot has planned and left HOME
blocker_position_3.webots_instructions: Start the run, then press 3 with the 3D view focused about 20 s after the robot leaves HOME.

blocked_corridor.description: Untested placement (stress test): blocker moves onto the team's planned HOME->A path at (-2.3, 0.0)
blocked_corridor.webots_instructions: No Supervisor key reaches this spot: use tools/run_webots_batch.py --scenario blocked_corridor (the scripted driver moves the blocker at 15 s), or drag the red block to (-2.3, 0.0) in Webots about 15 s into the run.
